title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (exemplo)

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ExemploCorp VPN Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ExemploCorp VPN Gateway contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands through a crafted request.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: AcmeSoft Mail Server Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: AcmeSoft Mail Server contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to access mailboxes without valid credentials.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VelhoSoft Legacy Portal Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Entrada antiga que deve ficar fora da janela de tempo.
